title: Chapter 320
text:
After accepting the mission, Han Xiao felt even more motivated. The mission required the captain to not die. At this time, the door of the main control room was knocked open, and the passage was guarded by scavengers. He could only block the door of the main control room and keep all the enemies out.

Tut tut tut tut

A rain of bullets and beams came at him. The Hovering Shield Shuttles formed an electromagnetic shield and blocked most of the attacks. Those that escaped were blocked by the armor. Most of these scavengers were ordinary people. They were very weak, but they had lethal weapons. There were gunpowder guns, electromagnetic guns, and even beam guns. Although they were the weakest weapons, the focus fire still gave Han Xiao some pressure.

Serpent Braid struggled to get up. He was still stunned. The three psychic attacks did not deal much damage, but the debuff made him feel very uncomfortable. This was because he had been careless. When he saw that Han Xiao was wearing a mechanical suit, he thought that he was a Mechanic. He did not expect that he could use psychic attacks. However, psychic attacks did not have any warning signs.

After suffering a small loss, Serpent Braid had a rough idea of Han Xiao's strength. He was a strong enemy that was not weaker than the Green Knight!

Serpent Braid was very competitive. Just as he was about to raise his hammer and charge, Cesoly's voice came from the communicator.

"Boss, this spaceship is approaching the warning zone. We don't have much time left. Don't waste time on a strong enemy. Quickly take over the main control room!"

Serpent Braid frowned and suppressed his fighting spirit. He whistled and shouted, "Guys, focus fire!"

His subordinates immediately opened fire, and the pressure on Han Xiao increased.

Serpent Braid raised his hammer and wanted to use the opportunity when Han Xiao was distracted to go around him and rush into the main control room.

As long as they seized the main control room, they could turn off the shield, and the scavengers in the outer space would be able to destroy the spaceship at any time. It was the same for the passengers when they lost the ship, so everyone on the ship could only surrender. That way, there would be no need to fight anymore.

Han Xiao was suppressed by the firepower and could not escape. His eyes flashed, and four sonic spheres flew out and blocked in front of Serpent Braid.

In order to protect the main control room, he had to block the door and be focused on. Han Xiao deliberately entered a passive situation, but he did not panic at all. Kerlodd and a group of players were his backup. Once the backup arrived, he would be able to focus on dealing with Serpent Braid.

Serpent Braid had some strength, so Han Xiao could not go around him to deal with the minions first. Moreover, Han Xiao could not leave his position at the entrance. If he dealt with Serpent Braid first, the scavengers would be able to interfere. If he wanted to solve this problem, he had to use [Snake — Devil]. However, the effect was a seven-day cooldown.

The current situation was not so bad that he needed to use his trump card, so Han Xiao chose to restrain the enemy and delay until reinforcements arrived. He knew what to do.

The [Nerves Connection] allowed him to control the floating mechanical weapons. This technique was very useful as it allowed him to fight on two fronts.

Sonic Spheres and Magnetic Chain Split Blades attacked like butterflies. To Serpent Braid, they were like a group of annoying bees. They were agile and stinging. Serpent Braid wanted to withstand the attacks and rush over, but he was blocked by Han Xiao, who focused fire on him. He could not break through.

Serpent Braid was enraged. He swung his warhammer and destroyed one or two machines from time to time.

Bang, bang, bang!

As time passed, the durability of Amphiptere decreased by a lot. Han Xiao did not feel the slightest bit of heartache. He had brought many spare parts with him and dealt with them calmly. He basically took a defensive stance and neutralized Serpent Braid's attacks. He was like an unsurpassable wall, making Serpent Braid more and more furious.

"Boss, we don't have enough time. We can't take down the main control room!" Cesoly shouted in the comms again.

"Shut up!"

Serpent Braid was furious. He swung his warhammer crazily. Seeing that Han Xiao's mech was getting more and more damaged, he had the illusion that he could defeat this opponent in front of him with just a little more.

"Boss, don't be rash. Our target is Godora. That's the main point. It's fine if we can't seize this spaceship. We don't have much time. Don't worry about the main control room. Go find Godora first. As long as we take him away, the employer will pay us!"

"Aren't the people from Beast Hoof looking for the target?"

"They've searched half of the spaceship and still haven't found the target. The spaceship is too big, and they don't have enough manpower!"

Serpent Braid cursed. He suddenly put away his warhammer and retreated. He shouted, "Go, don't worry about this! Go capture Godora! "

The scavengers started to retreat. Serpent Braid gave up on the main control room that seemed to be within his reach. His obsession with Kerlodd was unusual.

At this time, Han Xiao finally knew the scavengers' target. He was slightly surprised.

So the scavengers were here for Kerlodd?

Making such a big fuss over one person, Han Xiao felt that there was definitely something going on!

"Inform everyone to change the plan. Give up on the main control room and focus on searching for Godora. Cesoly, take the hostages back to our spaceship. These hostages are worth some money. The rest of you, search for the target!"

Seeing that the chances of capturing Short Horn Star were slim, the scavengers changed their strategy. They would first capture the target, then leave in the spaceship they came in. There would be people guarding the scavenger spaceship that was embedded in Short Horn Star. This was the scavengers' escape route.

After giving the order, Serpent Braid glared at Han Xiao. His eyes seemed to be saying that he was lucky to have spared his life.

At this time, a golden light burst out from the other end of the tunnel. The spear flashed, and a few scavengers were pierced through the chest and fell to the ground.

Kerlodd finally arrived. He held Godora's spear in one hand and a golden shield in the other. He blocked the way.

Han Xiao and Kerlodd stood in front of each other, blocking Serpent Braid and the rest in the middle.

"Godora!" Serpent Braid was not surprised. He did not expect his prey to appear just like that.

Looking at the situation, Serpent Braid seemed to have understood something. He looked at Han Xiao and said arrogantly, "So, you're in cahoots with the Godorans. You wanted to work together to deal with us. Humph, you delivered the target I wanted right to my doorstep!"

This development was exactly what Serpent Braid wanted. He did not have to look for his target everywhere. He just had to defeat and capture Godora.

Serpent Braid shouted and rushed toward Kerlodd with his warhammer.

Dong!

Kerlodd raised his shield to block, but his arm went soft. He could not withstand Serpent Braid's strength.

Just as Serpent Braid was about to chase after him, more than ten players appeared behind Kerlodd. They were all Supers with a certain level of combat power. The scavengers' advantage in numbers was gone. With so many Supers, it was more than enough to wipe them all out!

Shock finally appeared on Serpent Braid's face. His impulsiveness and anger turned into shock.

How could there be so many Supers in this low-level tour group?

Before they took action, the scavengers had estimated the strength of Short Horn Star. Logically speaking, the Supers in low-level tour groups would at most be Grade C, and they would not be too strong. The strong were usually quite rich. If they had the money, they would definitely buy their own spaceships. Even if they did not, they would still take a higher-level tour group. For example, low-level tour groups like Short Horn Star were like buses, while high-level tour groups were like trains and high-speed trains.

Serpent Braid was already surprised by the appearance of the Green Knight, but now, there were so many Supers with Grade C strength. This was completely out of his expectations. Where did these poor Supers come from? And they even came in groups!

I miscalculated!

Han Xiao chuckled. "I have helpers too."

The next moment, his smile disappeared, and he said coldly, "Go!"

Han Xiao, Kerlodd, and the others brazenly attacked Serpent Braid, who was caught off guard, and a one-sided massacre broke out.

The situation suddenly reversed!

"Sh * t! Boss is done for! "

Cesoly trembled as if a cold wind had pierced through his spine. He was currently in the economy cabin, leading a group of scavengers to guard the passengers and hostages.

"What should we do now? We can't save boss. Let's return to the spaceship first!"

Cesoly felt that the situation was out of control, and he felt uneasy. He only wanted to return to the spaceship as soon as possible so that he would have a backup plan. His mission was to bring the hostages onto the spaceship and comfort himself that this was not considered betrayal. He had no intention of helping Serpent Braid. Most scavengers were very selfish, and their loyalty was low. Cesoly was more concerned about whether he could leave safely.

"Boss wants me to bring the hostages back to the spaceship. Let's move quickly …" Cesoly could not wait to give orders to his subordinates.

But halfway through his sentence, Cesoly suddenly stopped and looked at the corner of the hall in a daze.

That corner was originally empty, but just a moment ago, a dozen people had suddenly appeared. Hao Tian, Sleepy Winter, Rainy Kim, Pork Bun, and a few other high-level players had agreed to finish their meal and come online at the same time.

The players looked around blankly, their faces filled with shock.

Hey, hey, hey. What's going on? Why are all the passengers captured? Who are these people with guns? Why is the spaceship shaking non-stop, and there are gunshots in the distance? Are they under attack?

The scavengers in the hall were all stunned, their eyes wide open.

When they kidnapped the hostages, they had checked all the rooms. Where did these people come from? Are they all ghosts?

Both parties stared at each other, their faces filled with confusion.

The scavengers subconsciously turned their guns. Hao Tian and the others saw this situation and immediately understood what was going on.

What the f * ck is there to think about? Kill them!

With a burst of energy, the scavengers were immediately pressed to the ground.

Cesoly was shocked.
